text: Hey team, looking into our auth requirements for the Events App. I strongly propose we use Firebase Auth instead of building a custom login system from scratch. It saves us 3 weeks of work and provides social sign-in automatically.
@alex.rivera Agreed. Let's document this in ADR 01 and confirm in Friday's engineering sync. We can't afford to debug custom token invalidation right before fest launch.
@alex.rivera Reminder: who is handling the payment gateway renewal with Stripe/Razorpay? In the task board I marked Alex as primary owner for billing integration.
Wait, no, Rohan Patel owns the payment gateway renewal! I only configured the test webhook endpoints. The legal account and renewal card are tied to club operations and Rohan.
